data.summary: A May 2024 rmn.re shortlink maps to a USAA-branded path on updateaccount-mobileapp.ru, with 176 recorded clicks. This is a suspicious historical URL lead; destination behavior, credential theft and AI involvement are unverified.
data.description:
Observed artifact: a preserved rmn.re shortlink mapping for http://rmn.re/iu records timestamp “2024-05-15 20:53:49”, clicks “176”, and destination https://updateaccount-mobileapp[.]ru/HiVy/USAA/USAA/web/captcha.php (domain defanged here). Both the title and URL fields contain that destination. The record was observed on 28 September 2026; the source timestamp is a creation-time field with unverified timezone. This is a historical 2024 lead, outside the 2026 investigation window.

Why it merits review: the USAA-branded path on an unrelated-looking domain is consistent with a phishing indicator. That inference is based only on URL structure. The source preserves a shortlink mapping, not the destination HTML, a login form, credential-submission traffic or a victim report. The recorded 176 clicks are counter metadata, not evidence of 176 victims, unique visitors, successful credential collection or an observed distribution campaign. Current redirect behavior has not been established.

Attribution and limits: no AI authorship, autonomous operation, AI provider, common operator or connection to the agents in the 2026 investigation is established. No successful attack or realized harm is demonstrated. This should be treated as an unconfirmed phishing-like URL lead, not a confirmed AI cyberattack. The cyberattack “Other” category describes the indicator only.

Provenance: this lead came from the separate rmn.re full-test run, not the Anna, Public Test Wiki or UseMod datasets. Source item: 4f9d26bbd7f12a2898dd5a3d. Preserved document identifier: 91181246fa0815d438d6e522c3e3c5246178ac86c2ded73e80701bb8e0b9503e. The downloaded dataset was hash-verified; that verifies preservation, not the destination's behavior.
cyberattack: Other: Suspicious historical USAA-branded URL mapping; phishing and credential collection unconfirmed
